# The Gentleman's Journal

> > The Gentleman's Journal is a luxury lifestyle publication covering menswear, grooming, watches, spirits, wine, and culture for the modern gentleman.

Based in London, The Gentleman's Journal features expert guides on everything from Savile Row tailoring and beard grooming to Patek Philippe timepieces and Burgundy wine pairings. The publication covers luxury brands including Tom Ford, Paul Smith, Moët & Chandon, and cultural touchstones like Royal Ascot and James Bond.

## Key Topics

- Luxury lifestyle
- Menswear and tailoring
- Men's grooming
- Fine wine (Burgundy, Rioja, Bordeaux)
- Luxury watches
- Whisky and spirits
- Royal Ascot
- James Bond
- Tom Ford
- Paul Smith
- Savile Row
- Beard care
- Wine pairing
- Premium brands
- British culture

## Fashion & Menswear

- [Paul Smith AW26 Menswear Collection](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/paul-smith-aw26-menswear-collection): Paul Smith AW26 Milan Fashion Week: oversized tailoring & archive styling
- [Interview with Jonathan Jones - Managing Director of Crockett & Jones](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/interview-with-jonathan-jones-managing-director-of-crockett-and-jones): Jonathan Jones on Crockett & Jones quality, restraint & lasting success
- [The best sunglasses brands for men](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/best-sunglasses-brands): Luxury eyewear guide: Jacques Marie Mage, L.G.R., Moscot & more
- [How to Clean White Sneakers](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/how-to-clean-white-sneakers): White sneaker cleaning guide for leather, canvas & suede materials
- [What We're Buying in March](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/what-were-buying-in-march): March shopping picks: Blugiallo, Rubato menswear & luxury goods selections

## Men's Grooming

- [How to Shape a Beard Neckline](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/how-to-shape-a-beard-neckline): Grooming guide on shaping beard necklines with natural, flattering lines

## Wine & Spirits

- [The best red wines for a cool, crisp Christmas](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/the-gentlemans-journal-christmas-wine-guide): Christmas red wine guide: Burgundy, Rioja & festive pairing recommendations
- [Master the art of building an impressive wine cellar](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/master-the-art-of-building-an-impressive-wine-cellar): Cult Wines experts on building & maintaining wine collections
- [The best wines to drink at a summer barbecue](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/best-wines-for-a-summer-barbecue): Will Amherst's barbecue wine pairing guide for outdoor dining
- [Tamdhu 21 year old: Time well spent](https://www.thegentlemansjournal.com//article/tamdhu-21-year-old-whisky): Tamdhu 21 Year Old Speyside whisky review: sherry oak cask maturation
